abilities._comment: Was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches -- the ability never ran. The effects were WARD with ward_type 'STEALTH' and ARCANE_BARRIER 0, on a card that prints neither keyword. Stealth IS printed and comes from card data; the ability the card actually has is the unpreventable damage.

_comment:
Implementation copied verbatim from malign_blue, whose printed functional text is identical to this card's once each card's own name is substituted out. Everything that differs between them -- cost, pitch, power, colour -- comes from the card DB, not from this file, so the DSL is the same card twice.

THE COPY IS PINNED, not trusted: tests/test_copied_card_implementations.py asserts that these abilities still match malign_blue's and that the two printed texts still agree, so a later edit to one cannot silently leave the other behind. That is the insult_to_injury failure -- three printings of one sentence with three different implementations, the blue one missing a gate the others had.
